build.help_relevant:
-t,    --threads N              number of threads to use during generation (default: 8)
  -tb,   --threads-batch N        number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads)
  -tm,   --threads-mtmd N         number of threads to use during multimodal image processing (default: same as --threads-batch)
  -td,   --threads-draft N        number of threads to use during generation (default: same as --threads)
  -tbd,  --threads-batch-draft N  number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads-draft)
  -cd,   --ctx-size-draft N       size of the prompt context for the draft model (default: 0, 0 = inherits target context for DFlash/DSpark, otherwise loaded from model)
  -ctx-ckpt N, --ctx-checkpoints N
                                  max number of context checkpoints to create per slot (default: 32)
  --ctx-ckpt-spill-dir DIR, --ctx-checkpoints-spill-dir DIR
                                  spill evicted checkpoints to DIR (NVMe) instead of dropping them; empty disables
  --ctx-ckpt-live-n N, --ctx-checkpoints-live-n N
                                  max checkpoints with resident data when spill is on (default: 2)
  -ctx-ckpt-i N, --ctx-checkpoints-interval N
                                  minimum number of tokens between each context checkpoint.  (default: 512, <=0 disable)
  -ctx-ckpt-t N, --ctx-checkpoints-tolerance N
                                  the number of tokens before the full prompt to create the checkpoint.  (default: 5, <=0 disable)
  -ctx-ckpt-e NAME, --ctx-checkpoints-eviction NAME
                                  Eviction strategy for checkpoint. Accepts fifo, variance and auto. Auto defaults to variance. Variance preserves coverage and maintains uniform interval.  (default: variance)
  -b,    --batch-size N           logical maximum batch size (default: 2048)
  -ub,   --ubatch-size N          physical maximum batch size (default: 512)
  -no-fa, --no-flash-attn         disable Flash Attention (default: enabled)
  -fa, --flash-attn (auto|on|off|0|1)
                                  set Flash Attention (default: on)
  -amb,  --attention-max-batch    max batch size for attention computations (default: 256)
  -gap, --graph-attn-precision    Flash-attn precision under -sm graph (default: f16)
         --all-logits             return logits for all tokens in the batch (default: false)
  -cb,   --cont-batching          enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) (default: enabled)
  -nocb, --no-cont-batching       disable continuous batching
         --image FILE             path to an image file. use with multimodal models. Specify multiple times for batching
         --audio FILE             path to an audio file for multimodal models. Specify multiple times for batching
  -draft, --draft-params          comma-separated list of draft model parameters (--cpu-affinity pins the draft to E-cores on Intel hybrid CPUs, -cr LIST picks CPUs)
  -rtr,   --run-time-repack       repack tensors if interleaved variant is available
  -prexp-t, --prefetch-experts-threads N
         --cpu-affinity           pin CPU workers to the physical P-cores (hybrid CPUs only)
                                    - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on
  --spec-ckpt-mode MODE           checkpoint strategy for speculative decoding
                                  types: none, draft, dflash, dspark, mtp, ngram-cache, ngram-simple, ngram-map-k, ngram-map-k4v, ngram-mod, suffix
                                            --model-draft draft.gguf --spec-type dflash:n_max=4
  -wb,    --warmup-batch          run a warmup batch before measurement
         --threads-http N         number of threads used to process HTTP requests (default: -1)
         --pca-batch N            batch size used for PCA. Larger batch runs faster, but uses more memory (default: 100)

interpretation_notes: -np 1 means one server slot; -t and -tb determine inference worker counts.
cache_prompt=false disables KV-prefix reuse for each timed request; OS file/page cache can still be warm.
The /completion response field tokens_evaluated is used as the total prompt count.
tokens_cached is stored for diagnosis only and is never added to prompt_n.
n_predict=0 measures prompt evaluation without decoding output tokens.
TTFT is measured from request start until the first non-empty streamed content delta.
Server CPU-core use is process CPU seconds divided by wall seconds; values near 8 imply eight CPU cores were busy on average.
cgroup throttling is recorded, but a VM hypervisor can still impose host scheduling contention when cpu.max is unlimited.
